body: Unfortunately, the preset system has been reworked somewhat in 1.4.0. The new location for preset files is `starship/docs/.vuepress/public/presets/toml`. Could you revert this to the version on master and then update the preset files in there?

I can't actually see this symbol in the web browser due to font issues. Is this supposed to be a nerdfont symbol? If so, we'll need to change it over to unicode.

NerdFont symbols can go in the NerdFont preset if you'd like to preserve it.

Can we also add a test case here with a more polluted YAML content? Something that we might see in real life, e.g. with packages and flags. Could be a toy project with a few dependencies, or just something pulled from a random repo.

I'm not so concerned about it for this specific PR, but it would be a small amount of protection against future breakage.
Yes, it is a NerdFont symbol. Moved to the NerdFont preset.
Copy-pasted a stack file from Reanimate. https://github.com/reanimate/reanimate/blob/master/stack-lts-14.yaml
